messages.subject: Starts argument in pcountOpen
parts:
I am wondering if someone can give me some information on using the
starts argument in pcountOpen - How should I go about deciding what
would be appropriate starting values for a given species? By providing
starts is the model fitting faster?

Thanks

Pat Johnson

messages.author: 681fb59733e01a1e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Starts argument in pcountOpen
parts:
hi Pat,
 If you provide good starting values then it should require fewer evaluations of the likelihood and therefore improve the run time.
 Coming up with good starting values depends entirely on context, biology, temporal scale, covariates in the model (whether they're scaled or not) and a million other things......
 At some point it might be possible to invent some general rules for this, so if someone wants to contribute to unmarked they could work on that.
regards,
andy
